sentences.text:
This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is filed by the claimants being aggrieved of the award dated 15.12.2022 passed by the learned Second Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Itarsi, District Narmadapuram (M.P.) in MACC No.1/2022 ( Smt.
Urmila Bai and others Vs. Kripal Singh and others), whereby on account of death of deceased Indrapal in an accident which took place on 24.11.2021, learned claims Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.9,87,000/-.
2.

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the appellants that learned Tribunal has construed income of the deceased at Rs.6,500/- per month, whereas minimum wages even for an unskilled labourer on the date of the accident were to the tune of Rs.8,800/- per month.

3. Shri Vinod Kumar Trivedi, learned counsel for the respondent-insurance company, in his turn,
supports the impugned award.

4. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, when notional income of deceased is taken at Rs.8,800/- per month, then annual NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:6373 2 MA-2310-2023 income will come out to Rs.1,05,600/-.

Since age of the deceased at the time of the accident was 43 years, therefore, 25% will be admissible towards future prospect and, thereafter, since deceased was survived with wife and two children, when 1/3rd is deducted towards living expense, then net dependency of the family will come out to Rs.88,000/-.
Smt. Urmila Bai vs Kripal Singh on 10 February, 2025
When multiplier of 14 is applied, then total pecuniary compensation will come out to Rs.12,32,000/-.

Over and above which, claimants will be entitled to a sum of Rs.16,500/- under the head of last rites and another sum of Rs.16,500/- under the head of Loss of Estate plus a sum of Rs.1,32,000/- under the head of loss of consortium, taking total compensation to Rs.13,97,000/- in place of Rs.9,87,000/- awarded by the learned claims Tribunal.

5. Thus, there will be enhancement to the tune of Rs.4,10,000/- (Rupees Four Lac and Ten Thousand only), but since the appeal is valued at Rs.4,00,000/- and the court fee is paid accordingly, therefore, the enhanced compensation is restricted to Rs.4,00,000/- (Rupees Four Lac Only) , which shall carry interest @ 6% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition till the date of actual payment.
The other terms and conditions of the award shall remain intact.
6. In above terms, these miscellaneous appeal is disposed of.
7. Record of the learned Claims Tribunal be sent back.

(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE pp Smt. Urmila Bai vs Kripal Singh on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79739988/

The other terms and conditions of the award shall remain intact.
6. In above terms, these miscellaneous appeal is disposed of.
